name: io.github.frankxai/starlight-creator-mcp
description: Sovereign creator MCP: BYOK image/video/audio generation, taste scoring, provenance ledger and client-confirmed publishing on your own machine.

environmentVariables.name: OPENROUTER_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: OpenRouter key (text, images, video, transcription). Optional if stored via `starlight-creator-mcp setup`.

environmentVariables.name: MUAPI_KEY
environmentVariables.description: MuAPI key for the 226-model aggregated catalog.

environmentVariables.name: GEMINI_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Gemini key used as the vision judge.

environmentVariables.name: CREATOR_PACKS
environmentVariables.description: Path-delimited list of pack directories to load (defaults to the bundled starter pack).
